intelligence.ai_view: The envelope is the identity-preservation contract for intelligence in motion: provenance attached, fields fail-closed on unknown, one canonical identity, no shadow stores.
intelligence.essence: A Naya Intelligence Object (NIO) is the machine-addressable envelope through which a meaningful intelligence object moves through NayaPOWER without losing identity, provenance, state, governance, or intended use. It is an object CONTRACT — not a new database, not a new intelligence layer. Every NIO exposes a 20-field envelope; fields may be absent when genuinely unknown, but they must NEVER be fabricated. Nine canonical types: EXPERIENCE, EVENT, INTELLIGENCE, RULE, DECISION, ACTION, OUTCOME, EVIDENCE, LEARNING.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's an envelope for anything clever the system handles, dear — with all the important facts written on the outside: what it is, where it came from, who stands behind it. You may leave a line blank when you truly don't know, but you must never invent an answer.
intelligence.human_view: Imagine a sealed courier pouch for anything the system learns or decides. The pouch has 20 printed labels — what it is, where it came from, what it's for, who vouches for it. You may leave a label blank when you honestly don't know. What you may never do is write something on a label you made up — a fabricated field poisons every downstream decision that trusts the pouch.

machine_view.machine_section: nio_envelope: [nio_id, nio_type, version, status, owner_scope, source, meaning, intent, truth_state, authority_context, applicability, freshness, relationships, evidence, event_lineage, application_history, outcome, verification, learning_state, successor_context]. field_rule: absent-when-unknown, NEVER fabricated. nio_types: [EXPERIENCE, EVENT, INTELLIGENCE, RULE, DECISION, ACTION, OUTCOME, EVIDENCE, LEARNING]. lifecycle: CREATE → VALIDATE → GOVERN → INDEX → RETRIEVE → APPLY → OBSERVE → VERIFY → LEARN → COMPOUND → SUCCESSOR. storage_rule: no nio-database/ledger/memory/retrieval-engine — canonical persistence is Intelligent Blocks + Events. identity_rule: one stable canonical identity + explicit versioning; aliases are routing conveniences, never new identities. authority_rule: a machine may not infer authority from the NIO itself.

intelligence.naya_view: Wrap every intelligence object in the envelope and fill only what you can evidence. Leave the rest blank — loudly blank, not silently guessed. Reference the one stable canonical identity; never mint a new one for a routing alias. Let invalid objects stop at validation/governance — never hand-carry them past the boundary. Never infer authority from the envelope itself.
intelligence.simple_view: Think of a lunchbox with your name on it and a note inside saying who packed it, what's in it, and who it's for. If the note says something that isn't true, someone could get the wrong lunch. Never write a lie on the lunchbox note.
